name: dsdv_sh_sq
structural_change: S81-SAFE-FIX/SH 10-19 (SAFE-DESIGN item 5): ot_dsdv_fixed_issue kept the 128 x 76-b calendar in flops and compared every row against both contexts every edge (wire-bound: trial GRT overflow 285,158, M2 106 % at util 48 %). Replaced by ot_dsdv_walk_issue: calendar in 2 SRAM copies as row pairs (one read port per context), per context the current pair word + the next word read ahead (two rows an edge at any alignment, two 24-b compares), per context/engine 8-deep completion FIFOs. Contract: issue non-decreasing, <= 2 rows an edge on different engines, per-engine done increasing, <= 8 outstanding (compiler dv_layer_compile finish(), seal scan code 3). Edges identical to ot_s81_fixed_issue (bench lock-step 4 seeds + 4 pair seeds; compiled L14 113 rows / 28 two-row edges PASS). Reset landing 2 stages, io_hold 0.03. History: S81U-SEQ (S81-DV p4f..p4i, owner-approved DV plan): L1 sequencer leaf of dsdv_seq_host: ot_dsdv_fixed_issue (= ot_s81_fixed_issue compiled calendar, edge-identical issue / completion checks) + svc completion tag queue + one rung hop each way; flop-first / flop-last pins, die hold budget. S81U-SEQ3 (gate 10607befb: 37-level scan_index -> fault_code, 2,048-b runtime part-select dt_q[8*eng+:8], 1,871 reset loads): seal scan in three registered stages (row read / accumulate / closing check, seal +2 boot edges), completion tag select decoded (one-hot AND-OR), calendar rows / loaded bits / context fields / age / pending / command payloads off the reset net, pin-flop payloads ungated. S81U-SEQ4 (gate4 df8031f2c: the SEQ3 row read still synthesised as a 128 x 79-b $shiftx barrel, scan_index[1] 10,119 loads; age -> fault_code 41 levels, TT -879 ps): one-hot row pointer for the seal-scan row read; completion compare registered one edge ahead (dm_q); run-time fault flags registered (run_fault / fault_code +1 edge, status only); duplicate-issue check by a two-hot tree. gate5 7b7028b78 PASS 0 warn (scan fanout / depth gone, 573 ps; TT ins 291.8 / sp 28.4) but reg->reg -77.2 ps at cmd_d (age compare -> 128-row AND-OR): the issue compare registered one edge ahead too (im_q from the next age and the next row value).

job.purpose: S81-DV seq_host leaf dsdv_sh_sq to closure (TT setup / FF hold / DRC 0 + native audit).

pin_regs.reason: Source-registered (dsdv_seq_host header): every leaf input lands in a flop at the pin and every output is a flop; recipe pin_regs would add a second unpriced stage on every leaf seam.

Width = common seq_host leaf width 254.88 (N/S pins aligned with lk / vc, x unchanged); macros stacked on the E side at x 129.6 (pins face W toward the logic; >= 20 um from the N/S/E pin faces, 21.6 um channel) need H >= 146 -> H 151.2 = dsdv_sh_lk height (aspect 1.69). Util = (std + 7,788 um2 SRAM) / core, measured at the gate.
